recent_excerpts: A leaked Cellebrite document describes Advanced Unlocks, a dedicated appliance with an 8-meter range that unlocks iPhones with Stolen Device Protection enabled.
Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,413 CVEs, led by CVE-2026-96951 (CVSS 8.8), a Windows Mark of the Web bypass exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV.
Google's September Pixel bulletin patches CVE-2026-58704, a high-severity modem privilege-escalation flaw under limited, targeted exploitation, plus 109 other bugs.
